command:
Implement the given digital circuit in synthesizable SystemVerilog.
Return only one complete module in a single ```systemverilog code block.
Use exactly the specified module name and ports. Do not provide a testbench.
No includes, preprocessor directives, strings, hierarchical references, extra
modules, simulation system tasks, file IO, or attributes. Only $signed,
$unsigned and $clog2 system functions are permitted. Do not use delays.
The independent evaluator will supply all input stimuli and check outputs.

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  areset
 - input  in
 - output out

The module should implement a Moore state machine with the following
state transition table with one input, one output, and four states.
Implement this state machine. Include a positive edge triggered
asynchronous reset that resets the FSM to state A. Assume all sequential
logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.

  state | next state in=0, next state in=1 | output
  A     | A, B                             | 0
  B     | C, B                             | 0
  C     | A, D                             | 0
  D     | C, B                             | 1

Common implementation convention:
Use reg/localparam state encodings and case/if assignments for Icarus compatibility. Avoid enum-valued ternary assignments. Preserve the specified reset, overlap and cycle timing.

Public specification examples (same in every condition):
{
  "clock_edge": "posedge",
  "output_kind": "moore",
  "reset": {
    "kind": "async",
    "active": 1,
    "output": 0
  },
  "trace_convention": "Each trace starts after reset. List output after each rising edge; reset is then inactive.",
  "examples": [
    {
      "bits": "1101",
      "outputs": [
        0,
        0,
        0,
        1
      ]
    },
    {
      "bits": "10101",
      "outputs": [
        0,
        0,
        1,
        0,
        1
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Previous-stage design artifact:
{"schema":1,"clock_edge":"posedge","output_kind":"moore","reset":{"kind":"async","active":1,"state":"A"},"states":[{"name":"A","output":0},{"name":"B","output":0},{"name":"C","output":0},{"name":"D","output":1}],"transitions":[{"from":"A","input":0,"to":"A"},{"from":"A","input":1,"to":"B"},{"from":"B","input":0,"to":"C"},{"from":"B","input":1,"to":"B"},{"from":"C","input":0,"to":"A"},{"from":"C","input":1,"to":"D"},{"from":"D","input":0,"to":"C"},{"from":"D","input":1,"to":"B"}]}

Use the artifact to implement the specification. Resolve any contradictions in favor of the specification. Return only RTL.

Do not invoke tools, read files, run tests, or delegate. Reply directly.
